              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * @fileoverview Helpers for google.colab Python module.\n",
              " */\n",
              "(function(scope) {\n",
              "function span(text, styleAttributes = {}) {\n",
              "  const element = document.createElement('span');\n",
              "  element.textContent = text;\n",
              "  for (const key of Object.keys(styleAttributes)) {\n",
              "    element.style[key] = styleAttributes[key];\n",
              "  }\n",
              "  return element;\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// Max number of bytes which will be uploaded at a time.\n",
              "const MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 100 * 1024;\n",
              "\n",
              "function _uploadFiles(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const steps = uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId);\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  // Cache steps on the outputElement to make it available for the next call\n",
              "  // to uploadFilesContinue from Python.\n",
              "  outputElement.steps = steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  return _uploadFilesContinue(outputId);\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// This is roughly an async generator (not supported in the browser yet),\n",
              "// where there are multiple asynchronous steps and the Python side is going\n",
              "// to poll for completion of each step.\n",
              "// This uses a Promise to block the python side on completion of each step,\n",
              "// then passes the result of the previous step as the input to the next step.\n",
              "function _uploadFilesContinue(outputId) {\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  const steps = outputElement.steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const next = steps.next(outputElement.lastPromiseValue);\n",
              "  return Promise.resolve(next.value.promise).then((value) => {\n",
              "    // Cache the last promise value to make it available to the next\n",
              "    // step of the generator.\n",
              "    outputElement.lastPromiseValue = value;\n",
              "    return next.value.response;\n",
              "  });\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * Generator function which is called between each async step of the upload\n",
              " * process.\n",
              " * @param {string} inputId Element ID of the input file picker element.\n",
              " * @param {string} outputId Element ID of the output display.\n",
              " * @return {!Iterable<!Object>} Iterable of next steps.\n",
              " */\n",
              "function* uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const inputElement = document.getElementById(inputId);\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = false;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  outputElement.innerHTML = '';\n",
              "\n",
              "  const pickedPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    inputElement.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n",
              "      resolve(e.target.files);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  const cancel = document.createElement('button');\n",
              "  inputElement.parentElement.appendChild(cancel);\n",
              "  cancel.textContent = 'Cancel upload';\n",
              "  const cancelPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    cancel.onclick = () => {\n",
              "      resolve(null);\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Wait for the user to pick the files.\n",
              "  const files = yield {\n",
              "    promise: Promise.race([pickedPromise, cancelPromise]),\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'starting',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "\n",
              "  cancel.remove();\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Disable the input element since further picks are not allowed.\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = true;\n",
              "\n",
              "  if (!files) {\n",
              "    return {\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'complete',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  for (const file of files) {\n",
              "    const li = document.createElement('li');\n",
              "    li.append(span(file.name, {fontWeight: 'bold'}));\n",
              "    li.append(span(\n",
              "        `(${file.type || 'n/a'}) - ${file.size} bytes, ` +\n",
              "        `last modified: ${\n",
              "            file.lastModifiedDate ? file.lastModifiedDate.toLocaleDateString() :\n",
              "                                    'n/a'} - `));\n",
              "    const percent = span('0% done');\n",
              "    li.appendChild(percent);\n",
              "\n",
              "    outputElement.appendChild(li);\n",
              "\n",
              "    const fileDataPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "      const reader = new FileReader();\n",
              "      reader.onload = (e) => {\n",
              "        resolve(e.target.result);\n",
              "      };\n",
              "      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "    // Wait for the data to be ready.\n",
              "    let fileData = yield {\n",
              "      promise: fileDataPromise,\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'continue',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "\n",
              "    // Use a chunked sending to avoid message size limits. See b/62115660.\n",
              "    let position = 0;\n",
              "    do {\n",
              "      const length = Math.min(fileData.byteLength - position, MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE);\n",
              "      const chunk = new Uint8Array(fileData, position, length);\n",
              "      position += length;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const base64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk));\n",
              "      yield {\n",
              "        response: {\n",
              "          action: 'append',\n",
              "          file: file.name,\n",
              "          data: base64,\n",
              "        },\n",
              "      };\n",
              "\n",
              "      let percentDone = fileData.byteLength === 0 ?\n",
              "          100 :\n",
              "          Math.round((position / fileData.byteLength) * 100);\n",
              "      percent.textContent = `${percentDone}% done`;\n",
              "\n",
              "    } while (position < fileData.byteLength);\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  // All done.\n",
              "  yield {\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'complete',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "scope.google = scope.google || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab = scope.google.colab || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab._files = {\n",
              "  _uploadFiles,\n",
              "  _uploadFilesContinue,\n",
              "};\n",
              "})(self);\n",
              "</script> "
            ]

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Install/import libraries\n",
        "import cv2\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import precision_score, recall_score, f1_score\n",
        "\n",
        "# Ground truth:\n",
        "# 1 = face exists, 0 = no face\n",
        "y_true = [1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Viola-Jones detector results\n",
        "y_pred = [1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0]\n",
        "\n",
        "precision = precision_score(y_true, y_pred)\n",
        "recall = recall_score(y_true, y_pred)\n",
        "f1 = f1_score(y_true, y_pred)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Viola-Jones Face Detector Evaluation\")\n",
        "print(\"------------------------------------\")\n",
        "print(f\"Precision : {precision:.2f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Recall    : {recall:.2f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"F1-Score  : {f1:.2f}\")"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from torchvision.ops import nms\n",
        "import torch\n",
        "\n",
        "# Bounding boxes:\n",
        "# [x1, y1, x2, y2]\n",
        "boxes = torch.tensor([\n",
        "    [50, 50, 200, 200],\n",
        "    [60, 60, 205, 205],\n",
        "    [300, 100, 450, 250],\n",
        "    [310, 110, 455, 255]\n",
        "], dtype=torch.float32)\n",
        "\n",
        "# YOLO confidence scores\n",
        "scores = torch.tensor([0.95, 0.82, 0.91, 0.70])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Apply Non-Maximum Suppression\n",
        "iou_threshold = 0.5\n",
        "keep = nms(boxes, scores, iou_threshold)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Original detections:\")\n",
        "for i in range(len(boxes)):\n",
        "    print(f\"Box {i+1}: Confidence = {scores[i]:.2f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nAfter Non-Maximum Suppression:\")\n",
        "for i in keep:\n",
        "    print(f\"Box {i.item()+1}: Confidence = {scores[i]:.2f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nNMS removes highly overlapping boxes and keeps the highest-confidence box.\")"
      ],

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "def calculate_iou(box1, box2):\n",
        "    # box format: x1, y1, x2, y2\n",
        "\n",
        "    x_left = max(box1[0], box2[0])\n",
        "    y_top = max(box1[1], box2[1])\n",
        "    x_right = min(box1[2], box2[2])\n",
        "    y_bottom = min(box1[3], box2[3])\n",
        "\n",
        "    if x_right < x_left or y_bottom < y_top:\n",
        "        return 0.0\n",
        "\n",
        "    intersection = (x_right - x_left) * (y_bottom - y_top)\n",
        "\n",
        "    area_box1 = (box1[2] - box1[0]) * (box1[3] - box1[1])\n",
        "    area_box2 = (box2[2] - box2[0]) * (box2[3] - box2[1])\n",
        "\n",
        "    union = area_box1 + area_box2 - intersection\n",
        "\n",
        "    return intersection / union\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# Ground truth bounding box\n",
        "ground_truth = [100, 100, 300, 300]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Predicted bounding box\n",
        "prediction = [120, 120, 310, 310]\n",
        "\n",
        "iou = calculate_iou(ground_truth, prediction)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Ground Truth Box :\", ground_truth)\n",
        "print(\"Predicted Box    :\", prediction)\n",
        "print(f\"IoU              : {iou:.4f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "if iou >= 0.5:\n",
        "    print(\"Result: Detection is considered a good match.\")\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    print(\"Result: Detection has low overlap.\")"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import cv2\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create two synthetic frames\n",
        "frame1 = np.zeros((300, 400), dtype=np.uint8)\n",
        "frame2 = np.zeros((300, 400), dtype=np.uint8)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Draw a moving object\n",
        "cv2.rectangle(frame1, (100, 100), (150, 150), 255, -1)\n",
        "cv2.rectangle(frame2, (115, 110), (165, 160), 255, -1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Detect corners\n",
        "p0 = cv2.goodFeaturesToTrack(\n",
        "    frame1,\n",
        "    maxCorners=50,\n",
        "    qualityLevel=0.01,\n",
        "    minDistance=5\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Lucas-Kanade parameters\n",
        "lk_params = dict(\n",
        "    winSize=(15, 15),\n",
        "    maxLevel=2,\n",
        "    criteria=(cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS | cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_COUNT, 10, 0.03)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate optical flow\n",
        "p1, status, error = cv2.calcOpticalFlowPyrLK(\n",
        "    frame1, frame2, p0, None, **lk_params\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "old_points = p0[status == 1]\n",
        "new_points = p1[status == 1]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))\n",
        "plt.imshow(frame2, cmap=\"gray\")\n",
        "\n",
        "for old, new in zip(old_points, new_points):\n",
        "    x1, y1 = old\n",
        "    x2, y2 = new\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.arrow(\n",
        "        x1, y1,\n",
        "        x2-x1, y2-y1,\n",
        "        head_width=3,\n",
        "        length_includes_head=True\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Lucas-Kanade Optical Flow Vectors\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"X\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Y\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Number of tracked points:\", len(old_points))\n",
        "\n",
        "if len(old_points) > 0:\n",
        "    displacement = new_points - old_points\n",

        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from sklearn.mixture import GaussianMixture\n",
        "\n",
        "np.random.seed(42)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Background pixel distribution\n",
        "background = np.random.normal(\n",
        "    loc=[100, 100, 100],\n",
        "    scale=[15, 15, 15],\n",
        "    size=(500, 3)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Foreground pixel distribution\n",
        "foreground = np.random.normal(\n",
        "    loc=[200, 50, 50],\n",
        "    scale=[20, 20, 20],\n",
        "    size=(200, 3)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "data = np.vstack([background, foreground])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Train Gaussian Mixture Model\n",
        "gmm = GaussianMixture(\n",
        "    n_components=2,\n",
        "    random_state=42\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "gmm.fit(data)\n",
        "\n",
        "labels = gmm.predict(data)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Gaussian Mixture Model\")\n",
        "print(\"----------------------\")\n",
        "print(\"Number of Gaussian components:\", gmm.n_components)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nComponent Means:\")\n",
        "print(gmm.means_)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nComponent Weights:\")\n",
        "print(gmm.weights_)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))\n",
        "plt.scatter(\n",
        "    data[:,0],\n",
        "    data[:,1],\n",
        "    c=labels,\n",
        "    s=15\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Red Channel\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Green Channel\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"GMM Background-Foreground Segmentation\")\n",
        "plt.show()"

        "import numpy as np\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score\n",
        "import cv2\n",
        "\n",
        "np.random.seed(42)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Simulated ground truth\n",
        "ground_truth = np.random.randint(\n",
        "    0, 2,\n",
        "    size=1000\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Simulated GMM predictions\n",
        "predictions = ground_truth.copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Introduce some errors\n",
        "error_indices = np.random.choice(\n",
        "    1000,\n",
        "    100,\n",
        "    replace=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "predictions[error_indices] = 1 - predictions[error_indices]\n",
        "\n",
        "accuracy = accuracy_score(\n",
        "    ground_truth,\n",
        "    predictions\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"GMM Background Subtraction Evaluation\")\n",
        "print(\"--------------------------------------\")\n",
        "print(\"Total pixels:\", len(ground_truth))\n",
        "print(\"Correct predictions:\",\n",
        "      np.sum(ground_truth == predictions))\n",
        "print(f\"Accuracy: {accuracy:.4f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate frame-wise accuracy\n",
        "frame_size = 100\n",
        "\n",
        "frame_accuracies = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for i in range(0, 1000, frame_size):\n",
        "    acc = accuracy_score(\n",
        "        ground_truth[i:i+frame_size],\n",
        "        predictions[i:i+frame_size]\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    frame_accuracies.append(acc)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nFrame-wise accuracy:\")\n",
        "for i, acc in enumerate(frame_accuracies):\n",
        "    print(f\"Frame {i+1}: {acc:.2f}\")"

      "source": [
        "import cv2\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create two frames\n",
        "frame1 = np.zeros((300, 400), dtype=np.uint8)\n",
        "frame2 = np.zeros((300, 400), dtype=np.uint8)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Object moves from left to right\n",
        "cv2.circle(frame1, (100, 150), 30, 255, -1)\n",
        "cv2.circle(frame2, (130, 150), 30, 255, -1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate optical flow\n",
        "flow = cv2.calcOpticalFlowFarneback(\n",
        "    frame1,\n",
        "    frame2,\n",
        "    None,\n",
        "    pyr_scale=0.5,\n",
        "    levels=3,\n",
        "    winsize=15,\n",
        "    iterations=3,\n",
        "    poly_n=5,\n",
        "    poly_sigma=1.2,\n",
        "    flags=0\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Sample vectors\n",
        "step = 20\n",
        "\n",
        "y, x = np.mgrid[\n",
        "    step//2:300:step,\n",
        "    step//2:400:step\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "fx = flow[y, x, 0]\n",
        "fy = flow[y, x, 1]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))\n",
        "plt.imshow(frame2, cmap=\"gray\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.quiver(\n",
        "    x,\n",
        "    y,\n",
        "    fx,\n",
        "    fy\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Motion Estimation Vectors\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"X\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Y\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Average horizontal motion:\",\n",
        "      np.mean(flow[:,:,0]))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Average vertical motion:\",\n",
        "      np.mean(flow[:,:,1]))"
      ],

        "import numpy as np\n",
        "\n",
        "# Ground-truth image points\n",
        "ground_truth = np.array([\n",
        "    [100, 120],\n",
        "    [200, 150],\n",
        "    [300, 200],\n",
        "    [400, 250],\n",
        "    [500, 300]\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Reconstructed/projected points\n",
        "predicted = np.array([\n",
        "    [102, 121],\n",
        "    [198, 152],\n",
        "    [303, 201],\n",
        "    [397, 253],\n",
        "    [502, 297]\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate Euclidean error for each point\n",
        "errors = np.linalg.norm(\n",
        "    ground_truth - predicted,\n",
        "    axis=1\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Mean reprojection error\n",
        "mean_error = np.mean(errors)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Structure-from-Motion Reprojection Error\")\n",
        "print(\"-----------------------------------------\")\n",
        "\n",
        "for i, error in enumerate(errors):\n",
        "    print(f\"Point {i+1}: Error = {error:.3f} pixels\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\nMean Reprojection Error: {mean_error:.3f} pixels\")\n",
        "\n",
        "if mean_error < 2:\n",
        "    print(\"Reconstruction quality: Excellent\")\n",
        "elif mean_error < 5:\n",
        "    print(\"Reconstruction quality: Good\")\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    print(\"Reconstruction quality: Needs improvement\")"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import cv2\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create two frames\n",
        "frame1 = np.zeros((300, 400), dtype=np.uint8)\n",
        "frame2 = np.zeros((300, 400), dtype=np.uint8)\n",
        "\n",
        "cv2.rectangle(frame1, (100, 100), (180, 180), 255, -1)\n",
        "cv2.rectangle(frame2, (120, 110), (200, 190), 255, -1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# -------------------------\n",
        "# Sparse Optical Flow\n",
        "# -------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "points = cv2.goodFeaturesToTrack(\n",
        "    frame1,\n",
        "    maxCorners=100,\n",
        "    qualityLevel=0.01,\n",
        "    minDistance=5\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "p1, status, error = cv2.calcOpticalFlowPyrLK(\n",
        "    frame1,\n",
        "    frame2,\n",
        "    points,\n",
        "    None\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "old = points[status == 1]\n",
        "new = p1[status == 1]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))\n",
        "plt.imshow(frame2, cmap=\"gray\")\n",
        "\n",
        "for p_old, p_new in zip(old, new):\n",
        "    x1, y1 = p_old\n",
        "    x2, y2 = p_new\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.arrow(\n",
        "        x1, y1,\n",
        "        x2-x1,\n",
        "        y2-y1,\n",
        "        head_width=3\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Sparse Optical Flow - Lucas Kanade\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# -------------------------\n",
        "# Dense Optical Flow\n",
        "# -------------------------\n",
        "\n",
        "dense_flow = cv2.calcOpticalFlowFarneback(\n",
        "    frame1,\n",
        "    frame2,\n",
        "    None,\n",
        "    0.5,\n",
        "    3,\n",
        "    15,\n",
        "    3,\n",
        "    5,\n",
        "    1.2,\n",
        "    0\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "step = 15\n",
        "\n",
        "y, x = np.mgrid[\n",
        "    step//2:300:step,\n",
        "    step//2:400:step\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "fx = dense_flow[y, x, 0]\n",
        "fy = dense_flow[y, x, 1]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))\n",
        "plt.imshow(frame2, cmap=\"gray\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.quiver(x, y, fx, fy)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Dense Optical Flow - Farneback\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Sparse optical flow tracks selected feature points.\")\n",
        "print(\"Dense optical flow estimates motion for almost every pixel.\")"
      ],

        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, classification_report\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "# Classes\n",
        "classes = [\n",
        "    \"Car\",\n",
        "    \"Person\",\n",
        "    \"Bike\",\n",
        "    \"Bus\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Ground truth\n",
        "y_true = [\n",
        "    \"Car\",\"Car\",\"Car\",\"Car\",\n",
        "    \"Person\",\"Person\",\"Person\",\n",
        "    \"Bike\",\"Bike\",\"Bike\",\n",
        "    \"Bus\",\"Bus\",\"Bus\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Predictions\n",
        "y_pred = [\n",
        "    \"Car\",\"Car\",\"Person\",\"Car\",\n",
        "    \"Person\",\"Person\",\"Bike\",\n",
        "    \"Bike\",\"Car\",\"Bike\",\n",
        "    \"Bus\",\"Bus\",\"Car\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Confusion matrix\n",
        "cm = confusion_matrix(\n",
        "    y_true,\n",
        "    y_pred,\n",
        "    labels=classes\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Confusion Matrix:\")\n",
        "print(cm)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nClassification Report:\")\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    classification_report(\n",
        "        y_true,\n",
        "        y_pred,\n",
        "        labels=classes\n",
        "    )\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Visualization\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))\n",
        "\n",
        "sns.heatmap(\n",
        "    cm,\n",
        "    annot=True,\n",
        "    fmt=\"d\",\n",
        "    xticklabels=classes,\n",
        "    yticklabels=classes\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Predicted Class\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Actual Class\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Multi-Class Object Recognition Confusion Matrix\")\n",
        "plt.show()"
